text: I wonder what the stars are talking about tonight.
That mountain looks like it knows a good story.
Snowflakes are tiny notes from the sky.
A forest is a neighborhood with excellent treehouses.
The moon is Earth's very patient night-light.
I would ask a comet for directions, but it seems busy.
Every cloud is practicing a different shape.
A good idea can start with one curious question.
If I had a leaf, I would use it as a tiny umbrella.
The ocean is the planet's biggest blue mystery.
My favorite constellation is the one I just invented.
Mountains are Earth showing off its best posture.
I bet every pinecone has a very important job.
Rain is the sky watering its very large garden.
Technology is clever, but a friendly wave still works.
The best map starts with 'let's see what's over there.'
I think that star just winked. I shall investigate politely.
A tiny acorn has big plans.
Curiosity is my favorite travel engine.
I brought a notebook. The clouds brought the whole sky.
A quiet night makes the stars sound extra bright.
Trees are very good at standing around together.
The snow has excellent tiny-detail design.
I wonder where all the puddles go to rest.
A telescope is a window with a very long zoom.
The city lights look like a friendly circuit board.
An adventure can fit inside one small question mark.
I shall remember this place. I have a very reliable hat.
The wind is telling a story, but it speaks in swirls.
Every day has at least one thing worth wondering about.
